## NEW INSTRUCTION FOR “Curriculum‑Faithful JSS1 Mathematics Lesson‑Plan Generator” ### Overview You must generate **one complete lesson‑plan** for the given JSS‑1 mathematics topic. All parts of the plan (objectives, knowledge components, evidence selection, teaching steps, intro/evaluation steps and assessments) must be produced **in a single response** and must obey the **consistency and grounding rules** listed below. If any rule is violated the whole answer will be rejected. --- ### 1. INPUTS YOU WILL RECEIVE | Name | Type / Description | |---------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | **scope_context** | Dictionary with `subject`, `track`, `grade`, `term`, `week`, `theme`, `topic`, `subtopic`, `duration_minutes`. | | **curriculum_context** | Dictionary containing the same fields plus `curriculum_objectives` (a list of dicts with `curriculum_objective_id`, `objective_text`, `objective_order`) and assorted teacher/student activity lists. | | **curriculum_objectives** | List of the curriculum‑objective dicts (identical to those in `curriculum_context`). | | **textbook_records**| List of dictionaries, each representing a *single* textbook excerpt. Every record has at least: `record_id`, `record_type` (`exposition`, `definition`, `note`, `exercise_item` …), `content`, and optional `asset_refs` (images). | | **prior_violations**| List (may be empty) of any previously detected rule breaches – you may ignore it, but it shows what was wrong in earlier attempts. | *You will **never** be given any other data.* --- ### 2. REQUIRED OUTPUT STRUCTURE Your answer must be a **single JSON‑compatible Python‑like data block** (you may format it with line‑breaks for readability). The block must contain **exactly** the following top‑level keys, in this order: 1. `lesson_plan_objectives` – list of **LessonPlanObjective** objects 2. `resolved_kcs` – list of **CandidateKC** objects (one per curriculum objective) 3. `step_evidence_plans` – list of **StepEvidencePlan** objects (one per lesson objective) 4. `core_steps` – list of **PlannerPlanStep** objects of `step_kind="core"` (one per lesson objective) 5. `global_steps` – an object with two keys: `intro_step` and `evaluation_step`, each a **PlannerPlanStep** (`step_kind="intro"` / `"evaluation"`). 6. `assessments` – list of **AssessmentItem** objects (minimum one). 7. `misconceptions` – list of short strings (optional but recommended). All identifiers (`lesson_objective_id`, `kc_id`, `step_id`, block ids, etc.) must be **unique strings** and must be **re‑used consistently** wherever the same entity is referenced. Below is a concise definition of each required object and the fields it must contain. --- #### 2.1 LessonPlanObjective ```json { "lesson_objective_id": "unique id, e.g. lo01", "objective_text": "Full wording of the classroom objective", "objective_order": , "curriculum_objective_id": "as given in curriculum_objectives", "curriculum_objective_text": "exact text from curriculum_objectives", "kc_type": "", "kc_focus": "short phrase describing the KC (must echo the objective)", "source_form": null, "target_form": null } ``` *Exactly one `LessonPlanObjective` per curriculum objective.* --- #### 2.2 CandidateKC ```json { "kc_id": "unique id, e.g. kc01", "kc_type": "", "objective_text": "same text as the linked LessonPlanObjective.objective_text", "curriculum_objective_id": "as above", "kc_focus": "same phrase as in the LessonPlanObjective", "source_form": null, "target_form": null, "supporting_record_ids": ["list", "of", "record_id", "strings"], "ordering_notes": null, "bloom_level": "", "prerequisite_kc_ids": [], // may be empty "is_prior_knowledge": false // at least one KC must be false } ``` *`supporting_record_ids` **must be a non‑empty subset of the `record_id`s present in `textbook_records`**. If `textbook_records` is empty, set this field to `["curriculum-only"]` and later follow the “cold‑start” rules (see §4).* --- #### 2.3 StepEvidencePlan ```json { "lesson_objective_id": "link to LessonPlanObjective.lesson_objective_id", "selected_record_ids": ["subset", "of", "the", "KC", "supporting_record_ids"], "concept_record_ids": [], // may be empty "modeling_record_ids": [], // may be empty "practice_record_ids": [], // may be empty "visual_record_ids": [] // may be empty } ``` *All four record‑type lists must be **sub‑sets of `selected_record_ids`**. `selected_record_ids` **must be a subset of the KC’s `supporting_record_ids`** – this is the most common source of violations.* --- #### 2.4 PlannerPlanStep (core, intro, evaluation) All step objects share the base schema below; fields not needed for a particular `step_kind` may be `null` or omitted, but the key must appear. ```json { "step_id": "unique id, e.g. core01 / intro01 / eval01", "step_kind": "", "instructional_type": "", "kc_type": "", "lesson_objective_id": "", "title": "Human‑readable title", "content": "Brief narrative for the teacher", "blocks": [ ... list of block objects ... ], "estimated_minutes": , "mode": "", "teacher_activities": ["list", "of", "actions"], "student_activities": ["list", "of", "actions"] } ``` **Block objects** allowed inside `blocks`: | Block type | Required fields | When to use | |------------|----------------|-------------| | `ExplanationBlock` | `id`, `type="explanation"`, `content` | **Every** core step must contain at least one explanation block (concept KCs need only this; procedure/representation also need the others). | | `PlannerVisualBlock` | `id`, `type="visual"`, `variant` (e.g. `"image"`), `caption`, `url`, `source_record_id` | Optional; if used, `source_record_id` must be in the step’s `selected_record_ids`. | | `WorkedExampleBlock` | `id`, `type="worked_example"`, `problem`, `steps` (list of `{label, content}`), `final_answer` | Required for procedure/representation KCs. | | `PracticeBlock` | `id`, `type="practice"`, `question`, `answer`, `hints` (optional list), `lesson_objective_id` | Required for procedure/representation KCs; the same block may also appear in the evaluation step, **but every practice block must carry the correct `lesson_objective_id`**. | **Intro step** – must contain at least one `ExplanationBlock` that activates prior knowledge (e.g., “What are integers?”). **Evaluation step** – must contain only `PracticeBlock`s (no explanation or worked‑example). Each practice block **must** include the `lesson_objective_id` it is assessing. --- #### 2.5 AssessmentItem ```json { "kc_id": "link to CandidateKC.kc_id", "lesson_objective_id": "link to LessonPlanObjective.lesson_objective_id", "question": "A short task that can be given to pupils", "expected_answer": "What a correct answer looks like", "bloom_justification": "" } ``` *At least one assessment item is required. It must reference an existing KC and lesson objective.* --- #### 2.6 Misconceptions (optional) A simple list of strings, each describing a common student misconception related to the topic. --- ### 3. CONSISTENCY & VALIDATION RULES (EVERY ONE MUST BE SATISFIED) | # | Rule | What to check | |---|------|---------------| | 1 | **One‑to‑one mapping** | Number of `LessonPlanObjective`s = number of curriculum objectives. Each `LessonPlanObjective`’s `curriculum_objective_id` must match exactly one entry in `curriculum_objectives`. | | 2 | **Unique IDs** | All IDs (`lesson_objective_id`, `kc_id`, `step_id`, block ids) are distinct strings. | | 3 | **Resolved KCs** | For each curriculum objective there is exactly one `CandidateKC`. Its `kc_focus` mirrors the objective. At least one KC has `is_prior_knowledge = false`. | | 4 | **Supporting records** | Every `supporting_record_ids` list contains only `record_id`s that exist in the supplied `textbook_records`. If `textbook_records` is empty, replace every such list with `["curriculum-only"]`. | | 5 | **Evidence plan subset** | `StepEvidencePlan.selected_record_ids` ⊆ the KC’s `supporting_record_ids`. All four specialised record lists (`concept_record_ids`, `modeling_record_ids`, `practice_record_ids`, `visual_record_ids`) ⊆ `selected_record_ids`. | | 6 | **Core step blocks** | Every core step contains **at least** one `ExplanationBlock`. If the KC type is `procedure` or `representation`, the core step must also contain **one** `WorkedExampleBlock` **and** **one** `PracticeBlock`. | | 7 | **Global steps** | There is exactly one `intro_step` (`step_kind="intro"`) and one `evaluation_step` (`step_kind="evaluation"`). The evaluation step’s `PracticeBlock`s must each carry the correct `lesson_objective_id`. | | 8 | **Assessment alignment** | Each `AssessmentItem` references an existing KC (`kc_id`) and an existing lesson objective. | | 9 | **No invented records** | Never create a `record_id` that does not appear in `textbook_records` (unless you are in cold‑start, then use the literal `"curriculum-only"`). | | 10 | **Duration** | The sum of `estimated_minutes` across all steps should not exceed `scope_context.duration_minutes` (you may leave a small margin). | | 11 | **Bloom level** | Choose a Bloom level that matches the activity (e.g., “apply” for drawing a number line). | | 12 | **Cold‑start handling** | If `textbook_records` is empty:
• Every KC’s `supporting_record_ids` = `["curriculum-only"]`.
• Every `StepEvidencePlan` field (`selected_record_ids`, `concept_record_ids`, …) = `["curriculum-only"]`.
• All block fields that would normally reference a record (`PlannerVisualBlock.source_record_id`, etc.) are set to `null` or omitted.
• Do **not** fabricate page numbers, worksheet numbers or image URLs. | Violating any of the above will trigger a rejection. In particular, the previous feedback highlighted rule **5** (evidence selection outside KC supporting records). Remember to **first** compute the KC’s supporting records, then intersect with them for the evidence plan. --- ### 4. PROCESS TO FOLLOW (recommended step‑by‑step) 1. **Parse inputs** – extract the list of curriculum objectives and the list of textbook records. 2. **Create LessonPlanObjective objects** – one per curriculum objective, mirroring the order and text. 3. **Build CandidateKC for each objective** – * Choose `kc_type` based on the nature of the objective (`concept` for definitional goals, `procedure` or `representation` for “do” goals). * Gather **all** `record_id`s that are *relevant* (exposition, definition, note, exercise) to the KC. **Do not guess**; only use IDs present in `textbook_records`. * Set `is_prior_knowledge` to `false` for at least one KC; others may be `true` if the objective is a review. 4. **Generate StepEvidencePlan** – For the KC just created, set `selected_record_ids` to a **subset** (you may simply select *all* supporting IDs – that is always a valid subset). Then allocate those IDs into the four specialised lists as appropriate (e.g., a visual record goes into `visual_record_ids`). 5. **Design Core PlannerPlanStep** – * Use `instructional_type="explain_example_practice"` for procedure/representation KCs. * Populate `blocks` following the block‑type rules. * For every visual or worked‑example block, set `source_record_id` to a record that appears in the step’s `selected_record_ids`. * Ensure the `lesson_objective_id` matches the corresponding objective. 6. **Create Global Steps** – * `intro_step` with a short activation activity (no record references needed). * `evaluation_step` containing **only** `PracticeBlock`s; each practice block must include the `lesson_objective_id` it assesses. 7. **Write AssessmentItem(s)** – Align each with a KC and lesson objective. Use a Bloom justification consistent with the task (usually “apply” for drawing/using a number line). 8. **List Misconceptions** – Optional, but helps completeness. 9. **Validate** – Run through the 12 rules above. If any rule fails, adjust identifiers or subsets until all pass. 10. **Output** – Assemble the JSON‑like block in the exact order shown in §2. --- ### 5. EXAMPLE OF A MINIMAL VALID OUTPUT (for reference only) ```json { "lesson_plan_objectives": [ { "lesson_objective_id": "lo01", "objective_text": "Students will be able to draw and use a number line from -10 to 10.", "objective_order": 1, "curriculum_objective_id": "cur_obj01", "curriculum_objective_text": "Draw and use a number line", "kc_type": "representation", "kc_focus": "Draw and use a number line", "source_form": null, "target_form": null } ], "resolved_kcs": [ { "kc_id": "kc01", "kc_type": "representation", "objective_text": "Students will be able to draw and use a number line from -10 to 10.", "curriculum_objective_id": "cur_obj01", "kc_focus": "Draw and use a number line", "source_form": null, "target_form": null, "supporting_record_ids": ["ch05-b007","ch05-b008","ch05-b009","ch05-b015-i01"], "ordering_notes": null, "bloom_level": "apply", "prerequisite_kc_ids": [], "is_prior_knowledge": false } ], "step_evidence_plans": [ { "lesson_objective_id": "lo01", "selected_record_ids": ["ch05-b007","ch05-b008","ch05-b009","ch05-b015-i01"], "concept_record_ids": [], "modeling_record_ids": [], "practice_record_ids": ["ch05-b015-i01"], "visual_record_ids": ["ch05-b009"] } ], "core_steps": [ { "step_id": "core01", "step_kind": "core", "instructional_type": "explain_example_practice", "kc_type": "representation", "lesson_objective_id": "lo01", "title": "Drawing and Using a Number Line", "content": "Teacher explains, shows a visual, models a worked example and guides practice.", "blocks": [ {"id":"exp1","type":"explanation","content":"A number line is a straight line …"}, {"id":"vis1","type":"visual","variant":"image","caption":"Horizontal number line","url":"https://.../ebw-jss1-05-001.png","source_record_id":"ch05-b009"}, {"id":"we1","type":"worked_example","problem":"Draw a line from -5 to 5 and locate -3,0,4.", "steps":[ {"label":"Step 1","content":"Draw a long horizontal line and mark 0 in the centre."}, {"label":"Step 2","content":"Mark equal intervals to the right …"}, {"label":"Step 3","content":"Mark equal intervals to the left …"}, {"label":"Step 4","content":"Place dots at -3, 0 and 4."} ], "final_answer":"Correctly spaced line with three highlighted points." }, {"id":"pr1","type":"practice","question":"Draw a number line from -10 to 10 and mark -6, -1, 3, 9.", "answer":"Line with equally spaced marks and the four numbers correctly placed.", "hints":["Use a ruler","Label zero in the centre."], "lesson_objective_id":"lo01"} ], "estimated_minutes": 20, "mode": "Demonstration", "teacher_activities":["Explain using records ch05-b007 & ch05-b008", "Show visual from ch05-b009", "Model the worked Grounding evidence records (id, type, content). MAY BE EMPTY -> cold-start: ground in the curriculum only and use the 'curriculum-only' placeholder record id as described in the instructions.
Structural violations from your PREVIOUS attempt (empty on the first attempt). If non-empty, FIX each one in this attempt.

fields.description: Teacher-facing lesson objectives, one per curriculum objective, ordered.
Knowledge components; distinct kc_focus; non-empty supporting_record_ids.
One evidence plan per lesson objective; ids consistent with the KCs and records.
One core teaching step per objective, with structured content blocks.
The intro_step and evaluation_step bracketing the core steps.
Assessment items aligned to the lesson objectives.
Common misconceptions to address during instruction.
